ibps.title: IBPS Official Handwritten Declaration Text (2026)
ibps.text: I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required.
instructions: Write in your own running handwriting in English using black ink pen
Write on clean white unruled (plain) paper
Do NOT write in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS (leads to instant rejection)
Substitute your full name in place of '_______ (Name of the candidate)'
Crop to 800×400 px (10×5 cm) and compress between 50 KB and 100 KB

sbi.title: SBI Official Handwritten Declaration Text (2026)
sbi.text: I, _______ (Name of the candidate), Date of Birth _______, hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required. The signature, photograph and left-hand thumb impression is of mine.
instructions: Write in your own running handwriting in English using black ink pen
Write on clean white unruled (plain) paper
Do NOT write in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS
Include your Full Name and Date of Birth as entered in the application
Crop to 800×400 px and keep file size between 50 KB and 100 KB

rbi.title: RBI Grade B & Assistant Declaration Text (2026)
rbi.text: I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required.
instructions: Must be handwritten by the candidate in black ink
Do not write in capital letters
White paper only with 200 DPI resolution
Allowed size: 50 KB to 100 KB (800×400 px)

rrb.title: RRB Official Declaration Text (2026)
rrb.text: I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the statements made in this application are true, complete, and correct to the best of my knowledge and belief. In the event of any information being found false or incorrect or ineligibility being detected before or after the examination, action can be taken against me by the RRB.
instructions: Write in your own handwriting on white paper
Use black or blue ink pen
Keep the handwriting clear and readable
Do not use printed or typed text
